Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.297 (2026-10-10) [testing]
- **The auto-rotation's preset list no longer goes stale when a job is changed inside a PvP territory.** The list of what the autorotation will run is rebuilt only on a job change, a lease change from another plugin, or a settings change - never on a zone change - and the rebuild bakes in whether the current zone is PvP. Changing job while standing in a PvP map therefore left the list without the job's PvE rotations for everything that came after: the zone changes out of the PvP map never rebuilt it, the autorotation ran nothing for that job, and toggling the auto-rotation off and on did not recover it, because the toggle wrote its setting without refreshing the list. Reported from an Eureka Orthos run on 2026-10-10 (Samurai, job changed inside a Crystalline Conflict map minutes earlier; the auto list stayed empty through the rest of the session). A zone change now rebuilds the list, and the auto-rotation toggle refreshes it too, so the list can no longer cross the PvP boundary stale. This applied to every job, not Samurai alone; jobs whose last rebuild happened outside PvP were never affected.
- **The two autorotation freezes now write one line starting `FZ|` to the plugin log when they engage and when they release** (behind the existing combo-decision telemetry switch). The Pyretic/Acceleration-Bomb penalty scanner and the enemy reflect/counter-stance scanner both stop the rotation outright - target dropped or set to self, zero presses - and until now did so with nothing in the log, so a run that died under either looked identical to the autorotation doing nothing at all. The line names which scanner froze and when it let go.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.296 (2026-10-10) [testing]
- **Ninja combo-decision lines now name the number of mudra (Ten) charges held at the moment of the decision.** The new field sits between the target-health field and the consulted-status list on `CT|` lines: the live charge count on Ninja lines, `-` on every other job. This is the number that tells apart why a Raiton was thrown - charges about to cap versus the uptime clause - so Ninja's charge-pooling settings can be graded from real logs afterwards. No rotation behavior changes; the consulted-status list remains the only part of the line that can be cut short.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.295 (2026-10-08) [testing]
- **Swiftcast, Triplecast and the other "do not buy an instant cast" decisions now see the Dualcast that the Phantom Red Mage trait grants on every job.** Every one of those decisions asked for the older Occult Dualcast status. In the current Occult Crescent content the Phantom Red Mage trait grants the ordinary Dualcast status instead (the same status Red Mage has, 15 seconds, on whatever job is being played), so on every job except Red Mage the decisions read "no Dualcast" for the whole proc and went ahead: the auto-rez Swiftcast press, the Healer and Caster raise buttons, the Black Mage, Pictomancer and White Mage Swiftcast and Triplecast presses, the Summoner egi Swiftcast option, the Astrologian Lightspeed presses, and the substituted-Swiftcast refusal in the combo layer all spent a cooldown on a cast that was already free. The movement fillers that stand down under a held Dualcast (Black Mage, Pictomancer, Sage, Scholar, Summoner, White Mage, Astrologian) now actually do, and the Summoner Slipstream and Ifrit gemshine picks that cast on the move under an instant-cast effect now count it too. Both Dualcast statuses count; Occult Quick handling is unchanged.
- **The prediction of a Dualcast that is about to land now works.** It arms only after the proc has been seen once under the Phantom Red Mage support job, and it looked for the older status only, so it never armed; a Swiftcast or Triplecast chosen while the casting spell that grants the Dualcast was still running was therefore not held back.
- **Blue Mage no longer presses Swiftcast under a held Dualcast or Occult Quick in the Final Sting, Ultravibration and New Moon Flute opener sequences.** The sequence takes the free instant instead.
- **Every Swiftcast, Triplecast, Acceleration, Lightspeed and Occult Quick press now writes one line starting `IC|` to the plugin log**, at most one per action every 400 milliseconds. The line names the source (the auto-rez branch, the combo preset that put the action on the button, or "unattributed" for a hotbar press, a queued input or another plugin) and the state at that moment: Dualcast (both statuses), Occult Quick, Swiftcast, Triplecast, whether a Dualcast is incoming, and whether the character is moving.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.294 (2026-10-08) [testing]
- **A crash is fixed in the target-hostility check shared by every job's retarget feature (the Dark Knight Shadowstride retarget among them).** When a target's object wrapper carried no valid in-game address, the check passed that empty address straight into a native game function and the game crashed. An object without an address is now treated as not hostile, and the native function is not called for it; targets with a live address keep their exact previous verdicts.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.0.4.293 (2026-10-08) [testing]
- **The Paladin one-button rotation now holds the Atonement chain (Atonement, Supplication, Sepulchre) outside Fight or Flight instead of spending it mid-combo, so Sepulchre is ready to use when the window opens.** Stacks about to expire (under six seconds) are still used so nothing is wasted, and every decision inside the Fight or Flight window is unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.0.4.292 (2026-10-07) [testing]
- **The Auto-Rotation now runs the Black Mage area rotation when exactly two enemies are in range of the best area target, instead of staying on the single-target rotation until the configured enemy count (three by default).** Black Mage's area rotation already picks Blizzard IV over Freeze at exactly two targets; that pick was unreachable through the Auto-Rotation because the enemy-count gate sent every job back to the single-target rotation below the configured count. Every other job and every other enemy count behave exactly as before, and a disabled area rotation still disables the behavior.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
